protocol.factor: Exact dense Cholesky postquantized uniformly to FP32, decoded to FP64 for oracle application; identical factor in all branches.
protocol.split: Fixed longest-feature-axis stable median partition of original rows; reorder mask by [S,R]. Fresh candidates [D z,(I-D)z], z=diag(H,lambda^-1 I) r in fixed congruence coordinates. Split AFTER preconditioning.
protocol.recurrence: Two-pass full G-orthogonalization and local Galerkin minimization. Initial-split control advances last block by M G using its already stored G image. Scalar-full-history isolates orthogonalization benefits.
protocol.reference: Moufawad, Flexibly Enlarged Conjugate Gradient Methods, arXiv:2305.19013v2 Section2.2 Algorithm2 https://arxiv.org/html/2305.19013v2 . Inspired by current-residual splitting; not a verbatim preconditioned MSDO-CG reproduction or novelty claim.
protocol.cost: One n^2 kernel traversal per action block, irrespective of width, is optimistic. Scalar RHS work separately counted. All history construction/storage, dense factor/kernel setup and per-step original stopping checks free except counted common setup/boundaries/final verification. No native timing or1MiB feasibility claim.
protocol.limits: 80/85 CPU; command120wall serialized flock;8CPU per solve; original relative1e-8;2000steps. No width or threshold sweep.
